description: Erection of a part two storey, part single storey training centre; a single storey site management and security building; access road; associated car parking; and hard and soft landscaping for a temporary period of five years.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - All the proposed temporary buildings, car parking and hard standing areas associated with this application shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition no later than the expiration of five years from the date of this permission in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Transport Assessment; Planning Statement; Air Quality Assessment; Ecological Appraisal; Energy and Sustainability Statement -Outline; Alternative Site Assessment Report; Design and Access Statement; Planning Statement; Construction Environmental Management Plan; Fire Statement; Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy; Operation & Maintenance Manual; Statement of Community Involvement; Life Cycle Design Services; GLA Circular Economy Statement; Circular Economy & Waste Management Strategy Report; 21129 001 P1; 2119 010 P20; 21129 050 P20; 21129 065 P20; 21129 100 P20; 21129 101 P20; 21129 105 P20; 21129 107 P20; 21129 180 P20; 21129 181 P20; 21129 200 P20; 21129 201 P20; 21129 202 P20; 21129 203 P20; 21129 204 P20; 21129 250 P20; Received 10/05/2022; BFC-BML-XX-XX-SK-C-0102 P03; BFC-BML-XX-XX-SK-C-0103 P02; BFC-BML-XX-XX-SK-C-0103 P01; Received 30/05/2022; 21129 SK220614-1 P1; 21129 SK220614-2 P1; 21129 SK220614-3 P1; Received 14/06/2022.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The external lighting hereby permitted shall only be operated between dawn until 9pm every day of the week.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first occupation of hereby approved training centre, the applicant shall prepare and submit to the Council for approval a programme of community use of the Site. The applicant shall implement and comply with the provisions of the agreed programme of community use for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan that conforms to current TfL guidance has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include: 
i. 	a site plan (showing the areas set out below) 
ii. 	confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused by construction activity 
iii. 	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv. 	provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site 
v. 	details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi. 	details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network 
vii. 	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
viii. provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council 
ix. 	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works 
x. 	measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access 
xi. 	commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts. 
xii. 	avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway 
xiii. all necessary traffic orders and other permissions required to allow safe access to the site to be secured and implemented prior

Condition : 6 - No construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Mondays to Friday and 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Within three months of occupation of hereby approved buildings, the unlawful structures hereby shown for removal by the Design and Access Statement shall be removed from the site and the land shall be returned to its former state.
Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall be in line with GLA's Circular Economy Statement Guidance.

Condition : 9 - The mitigation, compensation and enhancement actions identified within the Ecological Report shall be carried out until the development has been removed and the land is restored to its former condition to achieve net gains in biodiversity as outlined within the report for the site.

Condition : 10 - The maximum car parking spaces within the whole Site shall not exceed 180 and the existing 70 car parking spaces shall only be used for overspill parking in accordance with details to be set out in a Car Parking Management Plan There shall be no spectator parking in the overspill parking spaces. 
In the event that the Club is relegated from the Premier League to the Championship, the use of the existing 70 space car park area for the above purposes shall be ceased use and shut off within 6 months.

Condition : 11 - Prior to the occupation of the buildings hereby approved, the details of covered and secure cycle parking facilities for at least 60 bicycles shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved cycle parking shall be provided and made available for use prior to occupation and permanently retained for use thereafter.

Condition : 12 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a revised Travel Plan (which demonstrate the active measures the club will take to promote and facilitate sustainable and active travel by employees of Brentford FC to achieve and exceed the targets as set out in the permission. This should include but not limited to consideration of initiatives such as carpooling, shuttle bus, promotion of EV, cycling and public transport, including financial incentives to encourage modal shift, etc) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval and implemented in accordance with the timescales specified therein, to include those parts identified as being implemented before and following occupation, unless alternative timescales are agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - Prior to the occupation of hereby approved buildings, details of  25 no active electric vehicle charging points including location and manufacturer specifications shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The charging points shall be brought into use prior to first occupation of the approved buildings and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - The drainage strategy hereby approved shall be implemented and a maximum discharge rate from the developable area (including the pitch) must be no more than 3.5 litres/second. The management plan for the drainage system shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development and the management plan shall be put into effect before first occupation.
Condition : 15 - Prior to the completion of development, an amended drainage strategy shall be submitted and approved to show the improved half drain times of the attenuation features.

Condition : 16 - Within 6 months of the occupation of hereby approved buildings, a scheme showing proposed landscaping and landscape maintenance plan detailing the ongoing care and future replacement of all landscaping measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme and schedule shall be maintained during the lifetime of development.
Condition : 17 - The fire protection measures within the hereby submitted and approved Fire Statement shall be complied within during the lifetime of development.

Condition : 18 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until a revised Car Park Management Plan which shall include details regarding the management, use (including any future requirements should the club be promoted back to the Premier League following relegation), monitoring and enforcement of the overspill and permanent parking spaces has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed and used in compliance with this document.

Condition : 19 - A revised Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval and the approved plan shall be implemented upon occupation of the buildings hereby approved and the measures suggested shall be maintained for the life of the development.

Condition : 20 - Prior to the occupation of the development the post-construction tab of the GLA's Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment template should be completed in line with the GLA's Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment Guidance. The post-construction assessment should be submitted to the GLA at: ZeroCarbonPlanning@london.gov.uk, along with any supporting evidence as per the guidance. Confirmation of submission to the GLA shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, prior to occupation of the development.

Condition : 21 - Prior to the occupation of the development, a post-construction monitoring report should be completed in line with the GLA's Circular Economy Statement Guidance.  The post-construction monitoring report shall be submitted to the GLA, currently via email at: circulareconomystatements@london.gov.uk, along with any supporting evidence as per the guidance. Confirmation of submission to the GLA shall be submitted to the local planning authority, prior to occupation of the development.

Condition : 22 - Prior to the occupation of buildings, a pre-development and post-development UGF calculations to demonstrate compliance of development shall be submitted and approved to Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 23 - The temporary development hereby approved shall retain the existing ditches and streams with appropriate offset from the building to enable maintenance.
Condition : 24 - The development hereby approved shall be fitted with water efficiency fittings and other water saving measures to ensure water efficiency of development.
Condition : 25 - On-site plant and machinery shall comply with the London Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) Low Emission Zone standards.

Condition : 26 - The measures to control emissions during the construction phase shall be managed and maintained in accordance with the submitted and hereby approved Construction Environmental Management Plan.

Condition : 27 - Prior to the occupation of training facilities hereby approved, details of a new pedestrian access point in the south east corner of the site, to include details of works to the public highway to facilitate the access and link it to the existing footway on Jersey Road, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The approved access shall be constructed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the buildings hereby permitted and kept open and available for use for the lifetime of this development.

Condition : 28 - The adoption of the preferred energy strategy by the proposed fabric and building services specification and WLC emission estimation within the hereby submitted and approved Energy Statement and WLC Baseline Assessment shall be followed and complied within during the construction and lifetime of development.
